en.answer: In this scenario, if the effect of <<5740>> is applying when <<12712>> is Normal or Special Summoned, its effect that prevents your opponent from activating Spell/Trap Cards in response to the Summon is negated, so your opponent can activate a card like <<5400>>.
en.question: <<5740>> is face-up on my opponent's field, and the effects of all face-up monsters on the field are negated. In this situation, if I Normal or Special Summons <<12712>>, can my opponent activate <<5400>>?
